name: pressa
description: Publication-quality PDFs from Claude: invoices, contracts, reports, letters, CVs.
long_description: Pressa turns the documents Claude writes into publication-quality PDFs, with nothing else to install. It works without an account (a few short documents a day). Paste your API key from pressa.dev/dashboard to use your plan's limits, saved templates, images and logos.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Your key from pressa.dev/dashboard (starts with pressa_). Leave empty to try Pressa without an account.
